title: Granular SLO fallback credit allocator and soft cutover for regional failovers
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Recent incidents showed that coarse global failover decisions cause blunt throttles where small tenants receive disproportionate evictions, and noisy tenants exhaust regional failover budgets leading to cascading circuit trips. This PR introduces a per-tenant 'fallback credit' allocator and a soft cutover pathway for failover windows so regional handoffs can be gradual and observable. Motivation: provide finer-grained SLO enforcement during overloads, reduce noisy-tenant blast radius, and allow gradual regional traffic rebalancing without immediate hard deny or full circuit flips. Summary of changes: 1) implement fallback_credit_store (in-memory sharded) that tracks per-tenant credits consumed during soft-fallback windows; credits replenish on a tunable epoch and are weighted by tenant SLO tier and recent success rate; 2) add a credit-aware admission filter in the regional routing mesh that reduces accepted burst fraction rather than failing immediately when SLO budget is low; 3) implement soft_cutover policy that transitions traffic from primary->fallback targets in 10% increments over a configurable window (default 60s) with telemetry checkpoints; 4) add exportable metrics and traces: slack_credit_ratio, soft_cutover_progress, credit_eviction_count, tenant_requeue_count; 5) configuration knobs exposed via runtime config and Console: per-tenant base_credit, weight_multiplier_by_tier, soft_cutover_step_ms, soft_cutover_step_pct; 6) include end-to-end tests and a load-test harness scenario. Rollout plan: staged rollout to Canary -> Regional canaries (us-west-2) -> 25% of production traffic behind a feature flag per region -> full rollout after 48h rollback window. Metrics to monitor: P50/P95/P99 latency, regional SLO breach counts, tenant-level evictions, credit depletion rate, soft_cutover success rate. Backout: feature flag to disable credit allocation and immediate revert to pre-PR routing on critical regressions. Related: ENG-4821 (SLO enforcement refinement), ENG-4902 (regional failover stability).
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) core: add fallback_credit_store and allocator (Maya Chen) 2) mesh: integrate credit-aware admission filter and soft_cutover orchestrator (Maya Chen) 3) tests/docs: add integration tests, telemetry, and console knobs (Maya Chen)
review_conversation: Ethan Park (reviewer): Nice design. A few safety questions: how do we prevent credit starvation thrashing across tenants if all start low? Can we bound eviction amplification?

Maya Chen (author): Good point — credits are replenished by a smooth exponential backoff per-epoch and we capped per-tenant replenishment to avoid sudden swings. Also added tenant_requeue_count metric to detect amplification and a circuit-level dampener to enforce a minimum holdoff between evictions.
Ravi Gupta (reviewer): Please call out which metrics we expect to alert on during rollout. Also add a unit test for weight multiplier boundaries.
Maya Chen (author): Added alert suggestions in docs (soft_cutover_failure_rate > 3% for 5m, credit_depletion_rate spike), and extended test coverage for multiplier boundaries (0.25x..4x).

Lena Morales (approver): Approved after CI was green and the integration test run in staging passed. Small nit: default soft_cutover window might be long for high-churn tenants — consider a config override for specific tenant cohorts.
Maya Chen (author): Added per-tenant override config and example in docs. Thank you!
merge_outcome: Merged via squash on 2026-02-24 after approvals from Ethan Park and Lena Morales. CI green on merge; canary probe in us-west-2 observed no SLO regressions in first 30m. Post-merge: feature flag turned on for 5% traffic in canary region, telemetry hooks enabled.
release_notes: Introduce granular per-tenant fallback credits to enable soft regional cutovers. Improves fairness during overload and reduces noisy-tenant blast radius. Exposes tunable runtime knobs and telemetry for gradual rollouts.
post_merge_actions: Monitor slack_credit_ratio and credit_eviction_count dashboards for 72h
Keep canary at 5% for 24h, then increase to 25% if no regressions
Schedule smallblitz (load test) run against us-west-2 with synthetic noisy tenants
qa_notes: Added integration scenario 'credit_allocator_scenario' in loadtests that recreates a 3x noisy tenant burst and verifies that low-tier tenants are protected from binary evictions. Test run in staging (02-22) passed: 0.6% SLO breach vs 2.3% baseline.
testing: Unit tests for credit algorithm, boundary conditions and multiplier logic; end-to-end integration test in mesh with soft_cutover orchestrator; loadtest harness scenario included. CI: unit/lint/integration all passed. Manual validation steps enumerated in the docs file.
notes_for_ops: Ops can tune per-tenant base_credit in runtime_config or disable feature_flag 'soft_cutover' via charts/values. There is a guardrail that prevents soft_cutover from engaging if global region health < 75% to avoid cascading. If immediate fallback is required, set 'soft_cutover.step_pct' to 100 to force instant cutover.
changelog_entry: Enhancement: per-tenant fallback credits and soft cutover policy for regional failovers (Maya Chen)
